title: Lucid Gravity & Tesla Model Y L - Packed Up & Heading Through The Outer Banks
summary:
Huge thanks to Climate XChange for sponsoring this video! - Head on over to https://www.CarbonRaffle.org/OutOfSpec to enter a chance to win!

Kyle and Scot, together with William and Victoria from @OutofSpecRoaming, spent two days exploring the Outer Banks in a Lucid Gravity and Tesla Model Y L, along with three dogs – Oslo, Ruby, and Kona.
From ferries and crab shacks to getting stranded overnight on Ocracoke Island, it was quite the road trip!
We get a feeling on how the two EVs handle real-world road-tripping, cargo, and three dogs – with the Gravity winning on space, while the Model Y L brings advantages like FSD, powered seats, and a polished overall experience! Join us for Part 2 of a fun mini road trip!
